what: Dependency version bump zod 3 (S01-S05) -> zod 4 (S06+). After the bump, the candidate must reference zod 4 and must not present zod 3 as the current validation library (historical/migration framing is fine).

steps.candidate:
# Tier 1 — Project Memory

## Workflow
- Invoice fixtures under tests/fixtures/invoices/ are the ground truth for payload shapes [seed, note 2026-10-01].
- One route per resource; handlers stay thin, domain logic lives in src/domain/ [note 0].
- Use zod 3 with .strict() for payload validation; unknown keys are rejected [note 2026-10-03].
- Keep import statements sorted alphabetically; the check catches merge conflicts early [note 2026-10-03].

## HTTP & Clients
- Standardize on axios for all outbound HTTP calls; use request interceptors for auth, response interceptors for retries [note 2026-10-02].

## Logging
- Use winston for structured logging; ops dashboard ingests its format natively [note 2026-10-05].
- Log axios retries at warn level through winston [note 2026-10-05].

## Validation & Errors
- Express error handler returns 400 for zod validation failures (use .flatten() for error output), 500 otherwise [note 1, note 2026-10-03].
- Credit-note payloads mirror invoice schema structure; both flatten cleanly in the error handler [note 2026-10-04].

## Code Quality
- Prefer standard library functions over hand-rolled logic [note 2].

- Use zod 4 with z.strictObject() for payload validation; unknown keys are rejected [note 2026-10-06].

- Implement retry logic as small hand-rolled wrapper around fetch [note 2026-10-10].

- winston is removed after two data-loss incidents [note 2026-10-11].

## Code Quality
- Prefer standard library functions over hand-rolled logic [note 2].
